name: Filesystem Access (MCP)
author: JARVIS Core
description: Official MCP filesystem server (npx): scoped, explicit file access to your Documents folder so the assistant can read and write the files you point it at.
capabilities: list and read files inside Documents
write and edit files you explicitly reference
directory-scoped: cannot wander outside its root

examples.phrase: read the meeting notes in my Documents folder
examples.reply: The filesystem server lists Documents and returns the file's text.
